name: Hejőkürt (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hejőkürt: a red shield with a yellow horseman, a crescent and a star, with a bishop's hat and tassels, above a scroll inscribed HEJŐKÜRT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hejőkürt arms with hat and scroll
